evidence.title: CRSP US Stock Databases
evidence.claim_supported: The product covers more than 36,000 active and inactive securities, supplies daily and monthly market data and corporate actions, and uses PERMNO as a permanent identifier.
evidence.evidence_summary: Strong single-provider coverage and identity evidence, but the page does not establish historical knowledge-time vintages, licensing terms, or price.

evidence.title: PERMNO
evidence.claim_supported: PERMNO permanently identifies a security across its full lifecycle while PERMCO identifies the company.
evidence.evidence_summary: Directly supports stable security-level identity and separation from issuer identity.

evidence.title: CRSP US Stock and Indexes Database Guide, Flat File Format 2.0
evidence.claim_supported: CIZ defines daily open, high, low, close and raw share volume, historical security information, delistings, distributions, dates and permanent identifiers.
evidence.evidence_summary: Schema-level evidence for raw daily fields, reference history, actions and terminal events. It does not prove historical as-received vintages or complete 2016-plus field population.

evidence.title: CRSP US Stock and Indexes Databases Metadata Guide, Flat File Format 2.0
evidence.claim_supported: The metadata guide documents schemas, coverage statistics, flags and exchange calendars.
evidence.evidence_summary: Published historical population statistics show DlyPrc at 98 percent, DlyClose at 81 percent and DlyOpen at 60 percent overall; exact V1-period common-stock completeness remains unproved.

evidence.title: CRSP US Stock and Indexes Databases SIZ to CIZ Cross Reference Guide
evidence.claim_supported: The CRSP 1962 US Stock product maps to CIZ product code C6Z and includes historical security-information interval tables.
evidence.evidence_summary: Identifies the smallest current CRSP product and concrete CIZ tables for the conditional acquisition specification.

evidence.title: CRSP US Stock Database Release Notes, 2025-12 Monthly
evidence.claim_supported: CRSP publishes release-specific database notes and identifies corrections in a monthly release.
evidence.evidence_summary: Proves release versioning exists, but not that subscribers can acquire all historical release cuts needed for as-received reconstruction.

evidence.title: CRSP US Stock Database Release Notes, 2025-12 Annual
evidence.claim_supported: Annual releases revise historical names, identifiers, distributions, delistings and other historical records.
evidence.evidence_summary: Demonstrates that latest corrected history is not equivalent to the historical information vintage visible at an earlier cutoff.

evidence.title: Research Data Products
evidence.claim_supported: CRSP access paths include Windows and Linux, flat files, programming libraries, Snowflake, WRDS, MOVEit and CHASS.
evidence.evidence_summary: Supports Windows-compatible automated acquisition after licensing, not present authority to subscribe or download.

evidence.title: Policies and Statements
evidence.claim_supported: Use is governed by the subscriber institution's Standard Data Subscription Agreement.
evidence.evidence_summary: Public terms do not establish individual eligibility, local persistence, automated research, derived-data or post-cancellation retention rights; pricing is quote-only.

evidence.title: CRSP 10-Year US Stock Database Guide
evidence.claim_supported: CRSP10 is a rolling ten-year monthly classroom and workshop database.
evidence.evidence_summary: CRSP10 cannot supply the required daily V1 history and is explicitly excluded from the acquisition candidate.

evidence.title: Data Content Tables
evidence.claim_supported: Platinum includes daily US-stock history, delisted stocks and historical major-exchange listing indicators, but Norgate expressly makes no completeness claim for the delisted database.
evidence.evidence_summary: Useful operational coverage; incomplete survivorship proof and limited action/terminal metadata prevent V1 qualification.

evidence.title: Data Package FAQ
evidence.claim_supported: Delisted securities are presented under their final ticker and name; prior ticker and name history are not provided even though ticker reuse is recognized.
evidence.evidence_summary: Fails direct historical ticker validity and makes deterministic ticker-reuse reconstruction unavailable from the package alone.

evidence.title: AmiBroker Usage
evidence.claim_supported: Norgate AssetID is unique and unaffected by ticker or name changes; unadjusted close and volume are programmatically exposed.
evidence.evidence_summary: Supports stable internal identity but does not prove exportable historical ticker intervals or complete raw unadjusted OHLCV fields outside the proprietary database.

evidence.title: US Stock Market Data Packages
evidence.claim_supported: The minimum relevant Platinum tier is publicly priced at USD 346.50 for six months or USD 630 for twelve months.
evidence.evidence_summary: Price is transparent but cannot compensate for mandatory identity, event, vintage and licensing failures.

evidence.title: Subscribe to Norgate Data
evidence.claim_supported: Norgate is Windows-oriented and offers program integrations; ASCII export is limited to historical prices rather than all package features.
evidence.evidence_summary: Good Windows operation but weak portable reference/action export and proprietary-database dependence.

evidence.title: End User License Agreement
evidence.claim_supported: The license is for one natural person and two computers; after lapse the proprietary database is inaccessible and source and derived data must be deleted.
evidence.evidence_summary: The deletion and retention terms conflict with the project's immutable, reproducible local research-foundation requirement.

evidence.title: Sharadar Prices
evidence.claim_supported: The current direct product advertises more than 25,000 active and delisted securities with history from 1998.
evidence.evidence_summary: Supports broad coverage but not complete survivorship, historical listing venue, raw OHLCV or vintage semantics.

evidence.title: Stock Prices Schema
evidence.claim_supported: Open, high, low, close and volume are split-adjusted; only closeunadj is an unadjusted price field.
evidence.evidence_summary: Fails the mandatory full raw unadjusted OHLCV contract because reconstructing raw open, high, low and volume would require unsupported transformation or imputation.

evidence.title: Ticker Metadata Schema
evidence.claim_supported: Permaticker is described as a unique issuer identifier and metadata include FIGI, CUSIP and active/delisted state.
evidence.evidence_summary: Issuer-level scope is not the required tradable-security/share-class identity; historical validity intervals are not directly delivered.

evidence.title: Corporate Actions Schema
evidence.claim_supported: Actions include ticker changes, splits, dividends, spin-offs, listing and delisting events and acquisition counterparties.
evidence.evidence_summary: The schema lacks announcement/publication time, provider received time, stable event ID and historical revision chronology required by V1.

evidence.title: Frequently Asked Questions
evidence.claim_supported: History is rewired to the latest ticker, reused tickers receive a numeric suffix, historical primary listing venue is unavailable, and exchange is latest-only.
evidence.evidence_summary: Directly fails the historical exchange/listing interval requirement and limits historical identity fidelity.

evidence.title: Subscribe
evidence.claim_supported: Current direct subscriptions advertise products from USD 9 per month and a USD 29 per month bundle.
evidence.evidence_summary: The exact current tier and price that includes every needed table and full history is not established by the public selector.

evidence.title: Terms of Use
evidence.claim_supported: Direct access is personal and nonprofessional; on termination source and derived data must be deleted within thirty days and publication is restricted.
evidence.evidence_summary: Retention and use restrictions conflict with the durable reproducible V1 research-foundation requirement.

evidence.title: End-of-Day Prices Documentation
evidence.claim_supported: The API supplies raw and adjusted OHLCV fields; most US prices are available around 5:30 p.m. Eastern with corrections through approximately 8 p.m.
evidence.evidence_summary: Strong raw-bar and publication-timing support, but metadata are current and historical revisions are overwritten rather than supplied as vintages.

evidence.title: End-of-Day Stock Price Data
evidence.claim_supported: The product advertises raw and adjusted US exchange data, more than sixty years of history and REST access, priced at USD 30 monthly personal or USD 50 monthly commercial.
evidence.evidence_summary: Provides a low-cost operational bar source but does not supply the security-master, terminal-event or vintage contract.

evidence.title: Symbology Appendix
evidence.claim_supported: Tiingo says permanent ticker and delisted support are still expanding and supports delisted tickers only where the ticker has not yet been recycled.
evidence.evidence_summary: Directly fails complete stable identity, ticker-reuse and survivorship requirements.

evidence.title: Search Utilities
evidence.claim_supported: The search API is beta and describes permaTicker as an upcoming placeholder field.
evidence.evidence_summary: No currently documented exportable stable security identifier can support the mandatory identity contract.

evidence.title: Splits Corporate Actions
evidence.claim_supported: The splits endpoint is an early enterprise release and provides split ex-date data.
evidence.evidence_summary: Does not establish a complete action census, event publication times, terminal events or historical revisions for the purchasable EOD product.

evidence.title: Dividends Corporate Actions
evidence.claim_supported: The early-release dividend endpoint may provide ex, payment and record dates.
evidence.evidence_summary: No complete merger, acquisition, rights, spin-off, symbol-change or terminal-event source with knowledge-time semantics is documented.

evidence.title: Pricing
evidence.claim_supported: Published EOD pricing is USD 30 monthly or USD 300 annually for individuals and USD 50 monthly or USD 499 annually for internal commercial use.
evidence.evidence_summary: Public pricing is clear but does not overcome mandatory source gaps.

evidence.title: Terms of Service
evidence.claim_supported: Source data may be retained only while the subscription is active; derived-data use requires express written approval and source data must be deleted after lapse.
evidence.evidence_summary: The retention and derived-use terms do not satisfy the durable local research-foundation license requirement.

evidence.title: General Changelog
evidence.claim_supported: The changelog says EOD history can be queried by permaTicker for accounts that have permaTicker enabled.
evidence.evidence_summary: This conflicts with or narrows the current symbology and search pages that describe support as expanding or upcoming. Public documentation does not identify the entitlement, permanent-ID scope, mapping history, price or completeness, so stable identity remains unresolved rather than passed.
